patch.value: Typed parameter binding manifests: declare preset parameters once, resolve across settings, templates and seeds

From the 2026-10-21 fleet backlog audit item 2. Declare required preset parameters once in a typed manifest and resolve them consistently through settings, templates and seeds, returning unanswered choices before installation. Acceptance: (1) one supplied project parameter reaches every declared occurrence; (2) unknown/missing bindings refuse before any write; (3) secret values cannot enter generated public seed prose. Deliver typed SDK surface + CLI flags, compact TOON/JSON output, typed refusals with remedies, docs, property tests and real-data validation on a read-only copy of a public fleet tracker in a non-git temp dir.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Overlap check (re-run 2026-10-27 against pm CLI 2026.10.20 SDK and sibling packages): (a) pm-cli SDK has no parameter/interpolation capability — grep over the installed SDK declarations shows settings mutations are literal audited patches (mutateWorkspaceSettings), templates are literal option maps (loadCreateTemplateOptions/runTemplatesShow), client.create takes literal fields; no 'parameter|interpolat|substitut' matches in templates/workspace-contracts/schema declarations. (b) gh search issues --repo unbraind/pm-cli 'parameter binding'/'preset parameter'/'template parameter': no open upstream work. (c) Fleet sibling scan (src/docs) for parameter-binding/interpolation features: no hits. (d) In-package status: presets accept only a few CLI overrides (--prefix, --force, --dry-run, --replace, --with-seeds) and upgrades of known settings; seed and template values are static literals. Conclusion: no overlap — this adds parameter propagation as an explicit authoring contract while the resolved native fields are still validated by the existing core path (preset validation + the host's audited settings mutation), so no core schema change is required.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Real-data validation (2026-10-27), on byte-identical temp copies of this repository's public pm tracker in non-git temp dirs (GIT_CEILING set; the repo tracker itself was never touched): (1) READ-ONLY copy (chmod a-w): parameterized diff with projectKey=acme compared 13 settings leaves -> 1 add, 6 change, id_prefix 'acme-' vs stored 'pm-'; default-resolution diff reported the 'road-' default; supplying an undeclared parameter refused with typed code unknown_parameter listing the declared parameter; a full-file digest proved every tracker byte unchanged afterwards. (2) Writable temp copy: dry-run apply resolved 1 parameter into 3 binding occurrences (id_prefix + two template bodies, all showing acme); an invalid value (uppercase) refused with invalid_value before any write; a real --with-seeds apply read back through the SDK as id_prefix 'acme-', 2/2 template bodies carrying the occurrence, seed item titled 'Define the acme first roadmap initiative', 85 items after seeding (84 tracked items + 1 seed). (3) Note: the audited settings mutation takes a workspace-history lock, so a dry-run apply against the read-only copy refuses with a lock conflict - expected host behavior, mirrored by presets diff which reads without locks.

value.text: Re-review round 1 (2026-10-27): addressing all five blocking findings class-wide: (1) secret redaction in EVERY emitted surface (dry-run patch dump, diff results); (2) catalog/read surfaces become declaration-mode (required-no-default parameters no longer break show/apply-with-param; views flag unanswered choices and only apply/parameterized-diff refuse); (3) apply pre-validates seed bindings BEFORE the setup handler writes anything; (4) parameter values resolved ONCE at the apply boundary and threaded through settings, templates and seeds (no params-file re-read); (5) settings mutation + template writes serialized under a workspace-scoped apply lock. Merged origin/main (deps bump to pm-cli 2026.10.23) first; merge history verified as byte-identical prefix; re-installed the pinned host.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Re-review round 1 fixes (2026-10-27) — all five blocking findings addressed class-wide, each with an adversarial test that fails on behavioural revert: (1) SECRETS NEVER ENTER EMITTED OUTPUT: the dry-run patch dump and BOTH sides of every diff settings entry now redact resolved secret values via one primitive (redactSecretValues); summary lines were already redacted; read surfaces (show/list) keep secret occurrences authored because declaration mode never resolves secrets; the ONLY place a secret lands is the private settings.json an apply writes. Revert proof: removing the dry-run dump redaction fails 'dry-run apply redacts secret values from every emitted line'; removing the diff redaction fails 'diff results redact secret values on both sides'. (2) DECLARATIONS BEFORE ANSWERS: catalog/read surfaces resolve leniently (collectParameterValues) and never refuse for unanswered parameters (views flag unanswered, authored occurrences survive); apply and the parameterized diff preview keep strict refusals with the typed remedy; the unified apply now passes supplied values into the definition lookup, so --param answers questions instead of being ignored. Revert proof: restoring strict catalog resolution fails 6 tests (projection, show-with-unanswered, apply-with-param, seed pre-validation, boundary). (3) VALIDATE BEFORE ANY SIDE EFFECT: the unified apply resolves the preset id, every parameter AND the seed bindings at ONE boundary (resolvePresetApplication) before the setup handler runs; a malformed or secret seed binding refuses with settings and templates untouched. Revert proof: restoring post-handler validation fails both seed pre-write tests. (4) RESOLVE ONCE, THREAD EVERYWHERE: apply reads flags/params file exactly once, then threads the effective values through the handler (contextWithResolvedParameters) and into seed creation; applyPreset re-validates injected values (assertResolvedParameterValues) instead of re-reading input. Revert proof: restoring the re-read in the handler fails the injection and boundary tests. (5) CONSISTENT MULTI-PART WRITES: real applies hold a workspace-scoped O_EXCL lock (locks/pm-presets-apply.lock, owner token, stale steal, poll-then-refuse) across the audited settings mutation AND the template writes; dry-runs skip the lock (read-only trackers keep failing only on host locks); release deletes only a file that still carries the owner's token. Revert proof: removing the lock fails the held-lock serialization test (and the concurrent property test now asserts FULL consistency: surviving templates describe the same invocation as the surviving id_prefix). Also wrapped stack plan parameter refusals... removed again as unreachable — stack's candidates loop runs before its try block, so bundled-seed parameter refusals already surface as typed ParameterRefusals; no unreachable wrap shipped.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Continuing the published PR after reading its body and tracker evidence. Merged origin/main with two parents before implementation. Review rules: redact secret-bearing locations on both sides of rotation and before output encoding; normalize defaults and supplied values identically; resolve defaults at every seed consumer. Will audit SDK and CLI read/write/JSON/TOON paths, reuse applicable unpublished fixes without changing the previous worktree, add class-level adversarial properties and revert proofs, run focused tests then full gates with at most two workers, and verify packed npm/Bun consumers. Issues #171 and #173 are in this PR and included. No additional non-blocking findings appear in the supplied review or published inline reviews.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Class audit: settings dry-run was the only post-serialization value redaction; both diff command registrations share computeParameterizedDiff. Authored secret paths now travel on projected definitions so low-level computePresetDiff also hides rotated stored values of any JSON shape; direct SDK definitions infer sensitive scalar/array leaves from resolved secrets. Nested defense-in-depth redaction happens before JSON/TOON encoding. Seed consumers plan, stack, planSeeds, seedPresetItems and runPresetSeeds all use resolvedSeedsForPreset, which now collects manifest defaults without rereading files. Default collection and parameter views use the same normalization/constraints as supplied inputs, and injected resolutions reject noncanonical values instead of validating trimmed values then using raw ones. Added deterministic properties over Unicode whitespace, enum/pattern length boundaries, quote/backslash/Unicode/lone-surrogate secrets, rotations and nested settings shapes.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Revert proof: each mutation was applied alone, ran the matching adversarial property in tests/params-review.test.ts, then was restored in a finally block. All five mutations failed with exit 1: rotation (remove provenance and sensitive-leaf redaction); encoding (serialize before value redaction); seed-defaults (use supplied-only seed values); default-normalization (assign raw defaults); injected-normalization (accept noncanonical resolved values). Focused tracker-run command passed 50/50 with zero skips, including packed npm tarball execution under Node and Bun through both diff registrations, both JSON/TOON renderers, setup/apply dry-runs, stack identity/ownership and normalized show defaults. Two additional focused checks pass for parameterless seed validation and helper immutability. Strict tracker health passes with the current host; the older pinned SDK host sees a globally installed pm-github version skew, with no tracked extension implicated. Full release gates now running with two CPU affinity.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The full npm run exposed two existing SDK partial-result tests failing after the extra parameterless-seed guard eagerly invoked accessors. Stopped that already-failed gate to repair the regression. The guard now validates only enumerable data descriptors and returns original seeds, so native create still catches each accessor failure in order; original tests are unchanged. Added a no-accessor/non-enumerable regression alongside the undeclared-binding guard. The coverage runner now explicitly uses --test-concurrency=2 so local and CI release gates retain the requested bound independently of CPU count. Will rerun focused seeds/parameters, coverage, and both full release gates.

value.text: Final surface audit: catalog projections retain authored secret locations; computePresetDiff protects them even without supplied values, while computeParameterizedDiff also infers sensitive leaves for hand-built SDK definitions and redacts nested output values before rendering. Both diff registrations, normal JSON/TOON and strict rendering share that result. Setup aliases and unified apply share the pre-serialization dry-run path; plan, stack, seed plans and seed writes share the normalized seed resolver. Explicit workspace export and upgrade recovery artifacts are native configuration snapshots without parameter inputs; simulation uses isolated synthetic trackers. No second post-serialization parameter-redaction call was found. Packed regression fixtures use synthetic credentials only and never alter package source or the tracked project.

value.text: Final source review found an additional output-contract class in the continuation: redacting the entire diff tree could replace public control metadata when a secret equals a status, path component or identifier (for example change or match). Redaction is now limited to settings payload values; sensitive locations still redact both sides wholesale, including rotations and nested values. Added a property over all statuses and representative identifier/key collisions that preserves paths, statuses, preset identity, template/item-type metadata and counts while asserting both credential values are hidden. Stopped the in-progress Bun gate to repair this before publication; prior 270-test npm evidence is a checkpoint, and both complete gates will be rerun on the corrected source.
